summary: This bill requires the Transition Assistance Program for servicemembers leaving the military to include information and counseling about federal food assistance programs, such as SNAP and WIC.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends Title 10 of the U.S. Code, which deals with the armed forces, by requiring the Transition Assistance Program to include information on federal food assistance for veterans. While it touches on military personnel transitioning out of service, its primary focus is on food assistance and veteran welfare, not military spending or defense operations.
